fact: 1916年2月21日德军以第五集团军（皇储威廉指挥）在默兹河右岸发动凡尔登攻势，战役持续至12月18日；这是法尔肯海因“让法国流干血”消耗战略的执行，最终由法军收复失地。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Battle of Verdun"
sources.quote: Battle of Verdun, (February 21–December 18, 1916), World War I engagement in which the French repulsed a major German offensive. It was one of the longest, bloodiest, and most-ferocious battles of the war; French casualties amounted to about 400,000, German ones to about 350,000.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Battle of Verdun"
sources.quote: Local command of the operation was given to Crown Prince William, the eldest son of William II.

fact: 1916年5月31日至6月1日日德兰海战中，英国大舰队损失3艘战列巡洋舰、3艘巡洋舰、8艘驱逐舰，德军公海舰队损失1艘战列舰、1艘战列巡洋舰、4艘轻巡洋舰、5艘驱逐舰；人员损失两处大英百科全书条目的口径不一致（6274—6768人对2545—3058人）。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "World War I: The Battle of Jutland"
sources.quote: In all, the British lost three battle cruisers, three cruisers, eight destroyers, and 6,274 officers and men in the Battle of Jutland. The Germans lost one battleship, one battle cruiser, four light cruisers, five destroyers, and 2,545 officers and men.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Reinhard Scheer"
sources.quote: The British sustained greater losses than the Germans in both ships and men: three battle cruisers, three cruisers, and eight destroyers had been sunk against one battleship, one battle cruiser, four light cruisers, and five torpedo craft lost by the Germans; 6,768 British officers and men had been killed or wounded, against 3,058 officers and men killed or wounded in the High Seas Fleet.

fact: 1916年8月底，兴登堡与鲁登道夫接掌德军最高陆军指挥部（OHL，史称“第三 OHL”），法尔肯海因去职；新指挥部随即推出以军械与弹药产量大幅扩张为目标的“兴登堡计划”。具体任命日在不同来源中记为8月29日或8月31日。

sources.title: Imperial War Museums, "The First World War in Germany"
sources.quote: In August 1916 military commander Paul von Hindenburg was appointed Chief of the General Staff of the armed forces, and exercised a virtual dictatorship over Germany, conducting its military and civil policy.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Labor (Germany)"
sources.quote: The law was initially intended to flank the "Hindenburg Program", an ambitious plan devised by the Supreme Army Command (Oberste Heeresleitung) upon its appointment on 31 August 1916. The plan dictated almost utopian increases in the production figures for artillery guns of all sorts, machine guns, fighter planes and ammunition.

fact: 1916年5月，普鲁士官员在普鲁士战争部之下设立战争食品局（Kriegsernährungsamt），统一接管食品供应、分配与定价；这是在面包与面粉配给卡已实行一年后，把配给制度集中化的措施。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: In May, Prussian officials launched what was designed as a comprehensive approach to the increasingly volatile circumstances, including the establishment of a War Food Office under the auspices of the Prussian War Ministry.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: By January 1915, the new Imperial Grain Authority had banned farmers from foddering their grain and had issued ration coupons for bread.

fact: 1916—1917年冬被称为“芜菁之冬”（Steckrübenwinter）：马铃薯歉收与协约国封锁叠加，几乎所有食品以及煤等燃料都已实行配给与限价，城市居民以芜菁甘蓝替代主食。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: By the time of the historically frigid "Turnip Winter" of 1916-17, both rations and price controls had been implemented for virtually all food items, as well as for coal and other fuels.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: Questionable food sources outside of rural areas caused a host of enduring intestinal disorders, cynically termed "turnip disease" after the swede turnip (or rutabaga) the hated fibrous tuber that was sometimes the only easily available food.

fact: 原定1916年在柏林举行的第六届夏季奥运会因战争未能举办；该届主办权于1912年7月4日斯德哥尔摩国际奥委会会议上授予柏林，格鲁内瓦尔德的三万人体育场已建成，赛程原定5月28日至8月21日分段举行。

sources.title: International Olympic Committee, "The modern Olympic Games caught in the upheavals of history"
sources.quote: On 4 July 1912, at the 15th IOC Session in Stockholm, the IOC awarded the sixth edition of the modern Games to Berlin, rather than the other candidate, Alexandria, in Egypt.

sources.title: International Olympic Committee, "The modern Olympic Games caught in the upheavals of history"
sources.quote: Because of the conflict, the Games could not be held in Berlin.

fact: 1916年埃森食品的官方限价与黑市价出现巨大价差：小麦面粉官方价0.57马克/公斤、黑市5.35马克（约9.4倍）；马铃薯0.14对0.64马克；牛肉5.12对10.69马克；人造黄油4.03对10.69马克；糖0.64对2.67马克；鸡蛋每枚0.30对0.96马克；牛奶每升0.31对1.07马克。

sources.title: Matthias Blum, "Max Weber and the First World War: Protestant and Catholic living standards in Germany, 1915–1919" (TUM working paper), Table 2, source: Lange (1929)
sources.quote: Table 2. Official and black market prices for foodstuffs in Essen, 1916–1918 Product Unit 1916 1917 1918 Official Unofficial Ratio ... Wheat flour kg 0.57 5.35 9.38 0.58 8.02 13.82 0.65 11.76 18.09

sources.title: Matthias Blum, "Max Weber and the First World War", TUM working paper
sources.quote: Given scarcity of foodstuffs and the existence of maximum prices introduced by authorities the appearance of black markets was only a question of time, leaving authorities torn between protecting consumers and enabling markets to work efficiently.

fact: 以1913年为100，德国1916年食品价格指数为198、批发物价指数为152、生活费指数为170；同年美元汇率为132。限价与配给压低了名义物价，但市面缺货使指数低估实际生活成本。

sources.title: German History in Documents and Images, "Inflation (1913–1920)"（据 Jürgen Kocka, Klassengesellschaft im Krieg, 1973, p.17）
sources.quote: Year Dollar Course Cost of Foodstuffs Index (Cawler) Wholesale Prices Cost of Living Index (Federal Statistical Office /G. Bry) ... 1916 132 198 152 170

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, "Cost of Living", Table VIII（Wikisource 转录）
sources.quote: In Germany a calculation of a standard food budget based on official maximum prices in 200 localities was made monthly for the years 1914-9 (Deutscher Reichsanzeiger, Dec. 19 1919). Since the foods could not generally be obtained and there was much evasion of regulations the numbers have hardly even academic interest

fact: 在相对富裕的工业城市黑尔讷，1916年的“正常配给”只能覆盖成年人每日所需膳食脂肪的四分之一；配给热量长期低于维持体力劳动所需的水平。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: In relatively well-off Herne, "normal rations" in 1916 covered only a quarter of the daily dietary fats required by an average adult, according to scientists' new findings.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (Germany)"
sources.quote: In April 1917, a medical officer in Wiesbaden found that a loss of sixty pounds in healthy adults since August 1914 was "no rarity," even among those who made use of every means possible.

fact: 战时德国军工熟练工与普通工人的名义工资差距迅速拉大：柏林兵工厂的高级模具调整工日薪可达25马克，而小镇织布厂同行只有3.5马克；1918年9月前工业男工年均名义收入翻倍，电气工业接近三倍。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Labor (Germany)"
sources.quote: Whereas a highly skilled toolsetter in a Berlin gun factory might have earned twenty-five marks a day, his colleague in a small town weaving mill went home with three and a half marks.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Labor (Germany)"
sources.quote: This led to a doubling of the average yearly nominal income for male workers in industry until September 1918. Workers in the war-relevant industries profited disproportionately, with employees in the electronic industry almost tripling their yearly nominal income.

fact: 1916年12月5日《祖国辅助服务法》（Gesetz über den vaterländischen Hilfsdienst）公布，规定未入伍的德国男性须服国民辅助劳役；官方英译的年龄下限为18岁，其他来源记为17岁。该法把服役方向交由普鲁士战争部内的“战争局”决定，禁止雇主无离职证明雇用此类工人，违者可处一年以下监禁或1万马克以下罚金。

sources.title: German History in Documents and Images, "Auxiliary Service Law (December 1916)"
sources.quote: § 1. To the extent that he has not already been called into the armed services, every male German from the age of eighteen to sixty shall be obligated to participate in national Auxiliary Service for the duration of the war.

sources.title: GHDI, "Auxiliary Service Law (December 1916)", § 18
sources.quote: § 18. Imprisonment not to exceed one year and a fine not to exceed 10,000 marks, or either of these penalties, or detention, shall be the penalty for: (1) anyone who refuses employment assigned to him on the basis of § 7, Par. 3; (2) anyone who employs a worker in violation of the regulation in § 9, Par. 1

sources.title: de.zxc.wiki, "Hilfsdienstgesetz"（德文维基百科译本）
sources.quote: According to this law, all men between the ages of 17 and 60 who had not been drafted into the army or who had not worked in an agricultural or forestry company before 1916 were obliged to work in the armaments industry or in a war-important company.

fact: 1916年10月11日普鲁士战争部下令在军中开展“犹太人统计”（Judenzählung），按团队统计犹太信仰官兵在前线与后方的分布、阵亡与授勋人数；统计结果未公开，战后成为反犹宣传材料。

sources.title: Jewish Museum Berlin, "Georg Meyer (1873–1916)"
sources.quote: The cause was the Judenzählung or "Jewish Census," that was decreed by the Prussian Ministry of War on 11 October 1916.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Judenzählung (Jewish Census)"
sources.quote: The Prussian War Minister, Adolf Wild von Hohenborn (1860-1925) initiated the Judenzählung on 11 October 1916.

fact: 德国半年一次的战争公债在1916年仍能募得巨款：1916年春（第四次）认购107.12亿马克，1916年秋（第五次）105.62亿马克；但自1916年秋起公债收入已不足以冲销国库券，短期浮债开始持续膨胀。

sources.title: "German Finance"（Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922 条目转录，Theodora.com）
sources.quote: The first four war loans, with their subscriptions of 4,460 millions (autumn 1914), 9,060 millions (spring 1915), 12,101 millions (autumn 1915) and 10,712 millions (spring 1916), brought in sufficient to cover the Treasury bills issued up to that time.

sources.title: "German Finance"（Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922 条目转录，Theodora.com）
sources.quote: But from the autumn of 1916 this condition of affairs was altered. The war loans issued regularly every half-year continued to produce large amounts: 10,562 millions in the autumn of 1916

fact: 1916年9月帝国银行黄金储备25.03亿马克，纸币流通73.70亿马克；到1916年底硬币几乎完全退出流通，帝国银行转而以“贷款局票据”充作黄金准备金以规避三分之一黄金覆盖率。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "War Finance (Germany)"
sources.quote: To accommodate the growth of paper money in circulation, Hellferich and Havenstein pursued an aggressive publicity campaign to convince the German public to hand their gold over to the Reichsbank to augment its reserves and to place their trust in Germany's paper currency. By the end of 1916 virtually no specie remained in circulation.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "War Finance (Germany)", Table 3
sources.quote: Month-Year Specie in Reichsbank Notes in Circulation Sept-1914 1,787 4,491 Sept-1915 2,457 6,158 Sept-1916 2,503 7,370

fact: 巴斯夫在奥堡（Oppau）的哈伯—博施合成氨装置战前以肥料为目标，1914年末起转为生产硝酸供炸药工业；因空袭风险，1916年4月起在中德梅泽堡另建第二座合成氨厂（1917年投产），1916/17年产能升至10万吨氮，实际产量约6.1万吨。

sources.title: BASF, "1914 – 1918 / First World War"（企业史年表）
sources.quote: Synthetic ammonia was created, for example, to ensure food supplies for a growing population. But already faced with a shortage of ammunition by late 1914, the government accords the highest priority to the production of ammonia. At the Oppau site, it is converted into nitric acid and then supplied to the explosives industry.

sources.title: de.zxc.wiki, "Explosion des Oppauer Stickstoffwerkes"（德文维基百科译本，含 1916 年建厂与产能数据）
sources.quote: Even if the damage in the two plants remained low overall, after negotiations with the government, BASF began building a second nitrogen plant in central Germany in April 1916. ... Although the capacity rose to 100,000 t in 1916/1917, the actual production volume was not much more than 61,000 t of nitrogen due to various problems caused by the war.

fact: 兴登堡计划要求火炮、机枪、战斗机与弹药产量大幅跃升，并把经济纳入以战争局（Kriegsamt，格勒纳将军主持）为核心的指令性管理；1916年秋起大量新建与扩建厂开工，但同时造成运输与煤炭危机，产能目标直到1917年秋才部分达成。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Labor (Germany)"
sources.quote: Immediately, in the fall of 1916, comprehensive activities for the construction of additional plants and factories commenced without proper means to man them with qualified personnel. At the other end of the spectrum, the closings of allegedly "unimportant" production facilities sped up. A transportation crisis was the immediate effect, which also caused a serious shortage of coal.

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Labor (Germany)"
sources.quote: Only in the fall of 1917 were production benchmarks scheduled for spring met.
